summary: Swedish public radio reports the signing of the DCA, giving the US military access to 17 bases in Sweden; individual sites are not named.

title: Agreement on Defense Cooperation between the Government of the Kingdom of Sweden and the Government of the United States of America, Annex A „Agreed Facilities and Areas“
publisher: Government of Sweden (government.se)
summary: Annex A of the signed US–Sweden DCA lists the agreed facilities and areas the US may access and use, including Berga, Boden, Halmstad, Härnösand, Kiruna, Kristinehamn, Kvarn and Ravlunda.
note: Access and use rights under the agreement – not evidence of permanent stationing.
